name: What tools are needed for a basic lever faucet installation?

mainEntity.name: What tools are needed for a basic lever faucet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a standard lever faucet installation, essential tools typically include an adjustable wrench, basin wrench, pliers, screwdriver set (Phillips and flathead), a utility knife, and a flashlight. You'll also need plumber's putty or silicone sealant, and possibly pipe thread tape, depending on your specific faucet model and existing plumbing connections. Having a bucket or towels on hand is also recommended to catch any residual water when disconnecting the old faucet.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic tools for lever faucet installation include wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, and sealant. A bucket and towels are also helpful for cleanup.
